correctness.rationale: The entrywise pairing gives H=[[A,J],[J,A]] with A(t,u)=psi(tu+(tu)^(-1)). The unitary multiplicative-character basis maps v_chi to K_chi v_chi^-1, and 2-coset symmetry produces the exact singular multiset and determinant. Over odd F_p, Phi_p is irreducible over Q(mu_(p-1)), hence K_chi=0 would force constant coefficients of the trace-variable root-of-unity polynomial. Its coefficient at s=2 is one and at some omitted s is zero, contradiction. Triangle equality excludes K_1=±(p-1). For p=2 the matrix is all ones. The classical bound proves separation for p≥19. Direct independent matrix-vs-block SVD checks passed at p=2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19.

value.rationale: The Weyl normalizer of a split torus is a canonical sparse subset of SL_2 and provides a natural square Fourier reconstruction problem. The result gives an exact singular spectrum and all-odd-prime injectivity, detects the characteristic-two loss of rank, and quantitatively separates two spectral levels for every p>=19; these are structural reconstruction facts, not a finite arbitrary computation.
